data.body: **P2 — Update the published core compatibility guidance.** Releasing as 2.3.0 leaves `otel-plugin/README.md` describing the current compatible core as `2.2.2-SNAPSHOT`, while `OtelPluginSupport.requireSameThreadInvocationHooks()` and core Javadocs identify the requirement as 2.2.2. Users upgrading the plugin layer independently of their application SDK therefore receive stale upgrade guidance when construction rejects an older core. Update these references to 2.3.0, or use version-neutral capability wording, alongside the release bump.
